objective: Save/share-worthy education that builds trust and leads into the ERP page
audience: First-time buyers of billing software: small shop owners, restaurant and hotel owners, accountants advising them
concept: 6-slide buyer's checklist: 4 vendor-neutral questions (GST invoices, offline, data migration, growth) then how CodeLaksh ERP answers them
hook: Buying billing software? Ask these 4 questions first.
caption:
Buying billing software? Ask these 4 questions first.

1. Are the invoices actually GST-ready? Look for the CGST / SGST split, print and PDF, and reports you can hand to your CA.
2. What happens when the internet drops? Check what works offline and what needs a connection.
3. Can you bring your old data? Moving from Tally, Vyapar or manual books? Ask what migration help is included.
4. Will it grow with you? A second counter or branch shouldn't mean switching software.

Save this post for your next vendor demo, and send it to a friend who is about to buy.

CodeLaksh ERP covers all four: GST-ready invoices, a desktop app that works offline, a data migration add-on (Rs. 2,999 one-time) and branches and staff users on higher plans. 7-day free trial on Starter and Growth.
